name: disboardreminder
author: PhenoM4n4n
kirin
short: Set a reminder to bump on Disboard.
description: Port of phen-cogs' disboardreminder (archived). Thanks the bumper and reminds a channel two hours after each successful Disboard bump. Reads the settings the original cog saved.
install_msg: Unload and uninstall phen-cogs' disboardreminder before loading this; its settings carry over.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store new user data. Bump counts saved by older versions are kept and deleted on request.
